week5.summary: Green Bay led 14-0 before D'Andre Swift's 1-yard fourth-down TD run cut it to 14-7 at halftime, then pulled away after Christian Watson's 53-yard TD catch opened the third quarter. Jordan Love went 25-of-31 for 367 yards and two TDs, Watson had 143 receiving yards and two TDs, and the Packers defense forced five takeaways and held Chicago to 81 rushing yards. Caleb Williams (Grade 2 right hamstring strain) was listed questionable after a limited practice Fri Oct 9 but was ruled out; Tyson Bagent started.
